title: SparseSeg: Target-Conditioned Discovery Segmentation of Cryo-Volume Electron Microscopy Under Sparse Annotation
description: Source-code archive of SparseSeg, a target-conditioned segmentation framework for cryo-volume electron microscopy under sparse annotation. Includes the released analysis and benchmark scripts, environment specifications, example inputs and archived numerical benchmark tables. Based on code commit fb474ff22cf62d30376a82f166c78e64dd7a348d; this release adds citation metadata and the author-approved MIT license. Newly recomputed Figure 6b/c observations supplied with the postresponse manuscript are separate from the historical summary tables in this code snapshot.
